paragraphs: A student of Rabbi Akiva. He is mentioned in Taanit 22b, saying in Rabbi Akiva’s name: “One does not sound the alarm for pestilence at all.”[^1][^2]

notes.text: The supplied heading has bar Pitom; the William Davidson digital text of Taanit 22b has ben Pitom and explicitly calls him Rabbi Akiva’s student. The title preserves the supplied bar form.

The whole Davidson Taanit 22b paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Chanan ben Pitom as Rabbi Akiva’s student and reporting in his name. The supplied heading’s bar and the digital ben remain distinct. The local full titles and textual student description are supported; this does not admit an authority or teacher-graph relationship.
